{{Quote|Working for the ''Corellia Times'' is the culmination of a lifelong dream. Really. I love working with stubborn reporters who think a deadline is nothing more than a suggestion. Ah yes, my lifelong dream.|Finn Shallo|<ref name="SWG:Ftootvs" />}}
'''Finn Shallo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Go speak with Finn Shallo. He's an editor for the ''Corellia Times''. His writers are always doing stories about the Meatlumps.|[[Jesseb Convorr]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CSV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Starport Vandalism|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Finn Shallo worked in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] as an editor for the ''[[Corellia Times]]''. He was leading his own team of reporters and was known to be an expert on the Corellian terrorist and criminal organizations. During his career, he worked with [[Demmi Wot]], an ex-member of the [[Ragtags]] who helped him find information about those criminal groups.<ref name="SWG:CSV" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Finn Shallo agreed to help a spacer working for [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] and provided information about the [[Meatlumps|Meatlump criminals]]. Thanks to Shallo, the spacer discovered that the Ragtags were responsible for vandalism in the [[Coronet City Spaceport/Legends|Coronet Starport]].<ref name="SWG:CSV" />

Around the same time, Finn Shallo helped a spacer find the [[Vani Korr|owner]] of a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] with the ''Corellia Times'' logo on it retrieved from a [[Merkie Howzat|Meatlump sublieutenant]].<ref name="SWG:Ftootvs" />

==Behind the scenes==
Finn Shallo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ftootvs" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Finn Shallo was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> He was involved in two independent questlines: "[[Ral Mundi]]'s quest,"<ref name="SWG:TTE">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=other}}Quest: "Find the Missing Shipment of Starship Components"</ref> and "[[W:c:swg:Corellian Times Investigations|Vani Korr's quest]]."<ref name="SWG:Ftootvs" /> Ral Mundi's quest was later revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:CSV" />
